d: We are seeking an experienced Area Vice President – Front End Sales for the GCC region, with deep expertise in healthcare technology sales and strong familiarity with provider, payer, and government healthcare organizations in the Gulf. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role with significant performance targets. As the face of Innovaccer to healthcare organizations across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and the wider GCC, you will drive revenue growth, create and close large-scale deals across all three segments, and build long-term customer partnerships as Innovaccer grows its presence in the region.
Develop and execute a comprehensive GCC sales strategy, with individual account plans across provider, payer, and government accounts, aimed at exceeding revenue and growth targets.
Proactively create new business opportunities and build pipeline, including in accounts where Innovaccer does not yet have a presence.

Manage full-cycle sales from the initial discussion through closure, including lead generation, discovery, onsite and remote meetings, presentations and demonstrations, RFP and tender responses, proposals, contract negotiations, and partnering with Customer Success on future upsells.
Complete field sales responsibilities including sales forecasting, pipeline management, contact management, and ongoing assessment of the overall territory.

Sell Innovaccer’s solutions, including population health, payer analytics, patient access, revenue cycle, and the healthcare data and AI platform, to hospital groups and health systems across the GCC.
Engage health insurers and TPAs on risk, quality, care management, and analytics needs as mandatory insurance and payment reform expand across the region.
Pursue opportunities with ministries of health, regulators, and national health programs, managing government procurement and tender processes with discipline.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior executives (CEO, CFO, CIO, CMO) at healthcare organizations, as well as the business and operational leaders who influence buying decisions.
Maintain relationships with customers post-sale, in partnership with the Customer Success team, to ensure their goals are being met and to identify opportunities for upsells and co-development.
Drive timely progression of complex sales cycles, working closely with internal teams (solutions, product, legal, compliance, delivery, marketing) to execute deals efficiently.
Lead high-value negotiations and structure multi-year contracts for mutual long-term success, with a focus on deals that deliver measurable outcomes for the customer.
Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers on population health, value-based care, payer analytics, and healthcare AI in the GCC context.
Represent Innovaccer at regional industry events and conferences, creating credibility and interest in Innovaccer’s offerings.

Stay informed about market trends and regulatory changes across the GCC (for example CHI and payment reform in Saudi Arabia, and DOH, DHA, and JAWDA requirements in the UAE) to shape client strategies and positioning.
Collaborate with regional and global leadership on go-to-market strategy, partnerships, and pricing for the GCC.
Work with marketing, product, solutions, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and delivery of value to customers.
q: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of sales or business development experience in healthcare technology, with a substantial portion earned in the GCC or wider Middle East.
Track record of achieving quotas and closing multi-year, multi-million dollar healthcare SaaS and services contracts in complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes, including government tenders.
Experience selling to provider, payer, or government healthcare organizations, with the ability to hold persuasive business, clinical, and technology conversations with C-level leaders.
Working knowledge of the GCC healthcare landscape, including Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 health programs and payment reform under CHI, and UAE regulation and quality programs (DOH, DHA, JAWDA).
An established network of senior decision-makers within GCC healthcare organizations.
High EQ evidenced in excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills across cultures.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform sales strategies and client solutions.
Adept at using sales enablement tools such as Salesforce, outreach tools, and presentation development.
Ability to travel across the GCC (~50%), based in Riyadh, Dubai, or Abu Dhabi.
Experience with healthcare data platforms, EHR and claims data integration, population health, or payer solutions.
Working relationships with regulators and national health programs in Saudi Arabia or the UAE.
Experience selling alongside regional system integrators and consulting partners.

d: Mantis is a leading, conservation-focused hotel group with eco-lodges, waterways and curated eco-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco-tourism, safaris and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach-side escape or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass-produces sameness.

As a Graphic Designer, you will craft compelling visuals for both print and digital mediums, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and the hotel's positioning. Your role includes conceptualizing and designing diverse marketing materials, maintaining awareness of design and hospitality trends, and collaborating with teams to meet deadlines. You will support campaigns across departments, especially in social media and mobile marketing, while analyzing market trends. Additionally, you will manage e-tools, contribute to web strategy development, and provide professional service. Collaboration with Sales & Marketing is key for driving profit growth, alongside fulfilling ad-hoc responsibilities within hotel protocols.
What Is In It For You
Engage in conservation efforts and help preserve wildlife.
Enjoy sustainable adventures with exclusive rewards.
Celebrate locality and heritage in a vibrant community.
Advance your career with global development opportunities.
Drive change through impactful social initiatives.
Collaborate with a passionate, innovative team.
q: Technical Skills and Design Expertise: Proficient in graphic design software including Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Dreamweaver, Flash), MS Office, Corel Draw, and Acrobat. Strong technical understanding of web technologies (HTML, Flash, CSS, AJAX) and printing processes for both digital and print mediums. Creative design skills adaptable to current trends, brand standards, and market demands.

Project Management and Attention to Detail: Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and tasks of varying complexities, meet deadlines, and remain composed under pressure. Strong project management skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain high-quality standards.

Communication, Language, and Qualifications: Excellent organizational and communication skills. A degree in Graphic Design and/or proven experience in a similar role. Previous experience within the GCC region is highly preferred, with prior experience in the hospitality or luxury sector considered a strong advantage. Good understanding of luxury brand standards and environments. Excellent written and spoken proficiency in both Arabic and English is preferred, with strong reading and communication skills in both languages.
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

About Mantis Collection: Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco-tourism in a poverty-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.
Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

The ideal candidate will be guest-focused, outgoing, and service-oriented, with a genuine passion for hospitality and the ability to create a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

You should be enthusiastic, confident, and approachable, with strong interpersonal skills, a positive attitude, and a natural ability to engage with guests. A smart appearance, excellent grooming standards, and a warm, friendly smile are essential for this guest-facing role.
You should also be comfortable working in a fast-paced and vibrant bar environment, while demonstrating the following competencies:
